req.title: DELETE rejects unknown player
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 404 on DELETE for a non-existent playerId.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-015 requires DELETE /players/squadnumber/{squad_number} to return HTTP 404 when the squad number does not exist. The violation was: test[4] had kind=negative but heuristic=STC. STC (State Transition Coverage) is only valid for positive or boundary kinds in this rule set. Fix: change test[4] (test_delete_nonexistent_then_retry_still_returns_404) heuristic from STC to NEG, which is the correct heuristic for a negative test that verifies consistent 404 behavior on repeated calls to a non-existent resource. All other tests are preserved exactly as they were.

tests.name: test_delete_known_player_returns_204
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with 26 players including squad_number=10 (Messi)
trace: R-PLAYER-015: positive path — existing player deleted successfully, confirms route is functional and 404 is conditional on non-existence
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)
response = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/10')
assert response.status_code == 204
assert response.content == b''

tests.name: test_delete_nonexistent_player_returns_404
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with 26 players; squad_number=9999 does not exist
expected: Status code is exactly 404, not 400, not 500, not 204
trace: R-PLAYER-015: error pathway — DELETE for non-existent playerId must return 404
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)
response = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/9999')
assert response.status_code == 404
assert response.status_code != 204
assert response.status_code != 400
assert response.status_code != 500

tests.name: test_delete_nonexistent_then_retry_still_returns_404
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with 26 players; squad_number=500 does not exist
expected: System state is consistent across repeated calls for non-existent resource
trace: R-PLAYER-015: negative — repeated DELETE on non-existent resource must consistently return 404; catches mutations that alter state-check logic
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)
r1 = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/500')
assert r1.status_code == 404
r2 = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/500')
assert r2.status_code == 404
assert r1.status_code == r2.status_code

tests.name: test_delete_existing_then_same_squad_number_returns_404
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with 26 players including squad_number=5 (Paredes)
actions: Send DELETE /players/squadnumber/5 (player exists — should succeed with 204)
Send DELETE /players/squadnumber/5 again (player no longer exists — should return 404)
expected: Status codes are exactly 204 and 404 respectively
trace: R-PLAYER-015: decision table — covers both branches of the existence check: exists->204, not-exists->404; catches mutations that invert or remove the existence guard
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)
r1 = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/5')
assert r1.status_code == 204
assert r1.content == b''
r2 = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/5')
assert r2.status_code == 404
assert r2.status_code != 204
assert r2.status_code != 200
assert r2.status_code != 500
